name: Nutrition Recipe Agent
description: Generates BMI-aware recipe suggestions using USDA FoodData Central data and an OpenAI model.

capabilities.name: nutrition_lookup
capabilities.description: Fetches factual nutrition data for a food query via USDA FoodData Central.

capabilities.name: recipe_generation
capabilities.description: Creates a practical recipe suggestion conditioned on USDA nutrition data and BMI context.

query.description: Food query to look up (e.g., 'apple', 'chicken breast').

bmi.description: BMI value supplied by the Clinical Agent.

bmi_category.description: BMI category supplied by the Clinical Agent (e.g., Normal weight, Overweight).

result.description: Generated recipe text from the LLM.
